name: GT2 timing belt strip, 9 mm wide
summary: Straight belt strip with 2 mm pitch. Change Length in the inspector.
source: Generic 2 mm-pitch GT2-style layout strip, 9 mm wide and 1.38 mm total thickness. Tooth depth 0.75 mm and trapezoidal tooth faces approximate a commercial rounded profile. It is a purchased-belt space claim, not a mould or a manufacturing tooth definition. Adjustable length 2–2000 mm.
